sources.mapping: Moving steps and connected-move reactions apply to shadow-including descendants. isSubtreeRoot is independently determined for each descendant; it is not the move-bit.
Absent connectedMoveCallback selects the optional disconnected/connected callback fallback; its presence selects the move callback.
Applicable names/keyframes and matching-animation updates constrain persistence; changes to applicability cannot be ruled out from IsMove alone.
